info.title: Timestream Query supplement
info.description: The Query operation the Timestream smithy model does not declare but the mirror serves: not SQL, a substring match of the QueryString against stored database/table names, answering one ScalarValue row per stored record. Fused into aws.timestream by x-mirror-service; the vendored model keeps every other operation, its protocol and its shapes.

200.description: The fixed one-column header and one row per matching record, null rows when nothing matches.
